objective.statement: Get one independent cross-vendor second opinion on a finished answer, and escalate if the two vendors disagree.
objective.charter: Two seats, one from each vendor, same question, no shared context. Agreement between mechanically independent vendors IS the signal; disagreement is not a tie to be broken here, it is a promotion trigger. A dispatch is only complete on an AND-gate: exit 0 AND a non-empty output file AND a schema-valid parse. A process that merely exited is SEVERED, not SUCCESS.
success_criteria: both vendors returned a schema-valid artifact
neither seat saw the other's answer before writing its own
on disagreement the run escalates rather than averaging the two

context.briefing: Dispatch must BLOCK: no background, no job id, no 'check status later' receipt. Prompt travels by FILE, never inline, and the invocation carries --ignore-user-config.

all_of.note: Both rails returned. A single-vendor answer is not a second opinion.

all_of.producer: dispatch adapter: exit_code == 0 AND output-last-message file exists and is non-empty AND it validates against the caller schema
all_of.note: Blocking on process exit alone is NOT proof of completion; a foreground call that returns only a progress stream is SEVERED, not SUCCESS.

conditional_decision_requires: the disagreement is promoted to a heavier council or settled by an executable test

metadata.notes: HUMAN-STOP: all_participants_spoke == true AND custom:crossvendor_and_gate_passed == true | EDITABLE-DIALS: participants.roster[*].vendor and .model (vendor_pool) . budgets.time_minutes and stopping.hard_caps.max_minutes (timeout) | DESIGN-NOTE: the design wrote the rule as ANY[both_returned], but ANY with one operand is illegal in the expression grammar (a one-operand ANY is the operand itself) and the design's own note says the real gate is an AND-gate, so it is authored as the AND of both-returned and the three-part artifact gate | NO-SOURCE-EXPRESSION: a custom: leaf carries producer + note, which SEM-001 exact-equality forbids alongside source_expression; the HUMAN-STOP line above is proven equivalent by _probe_lane1_presets.py | OUTCOME-MAP: CONSENSUS -> decision . MAJORITY_WITH_DISSENT -> decision + dissent . disagreement -> irreducible_disagreement + escalation . DEFER and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE -> no_decision | BINDING: advisory.
